dialogue.ships: OH... YOU MOVE. I WAS FOLLOWING THE WARMTH.
dialogue.cells: SOMETHING SOFT HERE... WE CAN STAY A WHILE.

milestones.line: TEN? ... THERE IS MORE UNDER THIS ONE.
TWENTY PLACES... ALL THE SAME HUNGER.
THIRTY. I LOST THE PATH... FOUND SOMETHING SWEET.
FORTY CELLS... WERE THESE ALWAYS CONNECTED?
SIXTY. STILL EMPTY INSIDE... STILL GROWING.
SEVENTY... I THINK WE HAVE BEEN HERE BEFORE.
EIGHTY CELLS... LET THE OLD PARTS SLEEP.
NINETY... SOMETHING IS STILL WARM OVER THERE.
